notes.title: Kitfox Oceans Day Bundle Supporting WDC
notes.content:
Hey Cultists,

We all know how important it is to keep our ocean’s safe and clean for our underwater friends. Whales and dolphins are especially at risk of dangerous fishing practices and pollution. This is why we are partnering with the WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation to create a bundle of our games with 20% of the sales going directly to charity. Included in the bundle is Pupperazzi, Moon Hunters, Boyfriend Dungeon and Shrouded Isle. And to sweeten the deal, you’ll get 15% off if you own one (or buy them all at once)!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33081/Kitfox_Oceans_Day_Bundle/

Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused. Thank you in advance for supporting this excellent cause!

-Alexandra

notes.title: Welcome to Lovecraftian Days!
notes.content:
The human mind reels at the enormity and consequence of time that must follow from the fact that The Shrouded Isle came out in a year with a seemingly reasonable number (2017) and yet this means that, at time of writing, the Earth has revolved around the sun a full 5 times and is halfway towards a sixth!

It's been some years, is what I'm saying.

In honor of Lovecraftian Days (click through the banner at the top of the store page to find other eldritch delights), we're opening a portal through time to look back and ask the Kitfoxes of yesteryear a few questions, such as...

What is The Shrouded Isle?
Why is The Shrouded Isle?
How is The Shrouded Isle?

Surely you have no holidays of "rebirth" and "springtime" to attend tomorrow! So join us, you straggling remainders of the Houses past, to peer into the wonders of bygone eras:

Stream 1: Sunday April 9, 11am Pacific / 2pm Eastern
Stream 2: Sunday April 9, 6pm Pacific / 9pm Eastern

The spawn of a game jam, nurtured from a spore of potential, this game has since flowered and now reclines, sated, perhaps even bloated, with the adoration of the many it has consumed.

Be well, believers!
Tanya, Matron of House Kitfox

notes.title: 🌙 Pandemic Relief Fundraiser 🌙
notes.content:
In times of global uncertainty and change, the only way to get out of this tough situation is to go through it - together.

Kitfox Games is partnering with the United Nations Foundation to raise money for the [url=https://covid19responsefund.org/]World Health Organization’s COVID-19 response.[/url]

From [b]April 10th - 13th[/b], [b]all of Kitfox’s profits from our game sales (85% off!) will go to the WHO COVID-19 Relief Fund.[/b] [url=https://covid19responsefund.org/]More info about it here.[/url] Any of these game purchases will contribute to the fund: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/320040/Moon_Hunters]Moon Hunters[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/501320/The_Shrouded_Isle]The Shrouded Isle[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/305640/Shattered_Planet/]Shattered Planet[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/881420/Six_Ages_Ride_Like_the_Wind]Six Ages[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1110380/Fit_For_a_King/]Fit For a King[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26483943/88c69a370421c34ebee507fc22786fa0cba62b26.png[/img]

While Kitfox’s financial surplus is minimal, we know we’re privileged to be in a position where we can work from home and get paid. And so we felt it was important to try and give back to those who are more vulnerable or are working towards keeping us safe. We hope you’ll join us, either with a purchase, directly donating to a local charity, or the WHO.

Please share the sale or donation page, as every dollar will make a difference. Moments of togetherness are all the more important in times like these, and games have always been a powerful way to experience something together, but apart.

We hope you can remember to socially distance, wash your hands, and reach out to loved ones. Additionally, here are some [url=https://www.takethis.org/mental-health-resources/]mental health resources[/url]. 

Thank you for your support and stay safe.

<3
Victoria and the Kitfox Games team (Tanya, Xin, Jongwoo, Marcelo, Alex, Thea, Mehrdad, and Kira)

notes.title: Announcing: Lucifer Within Us!
notes.content:
Last night, we revealed our newest title: Lucifer Within Us, from the creator of the Shrouded Isle.

As a digital exorcist in Lucifer Within Us, you’re asked to solve murders, purify the possessed, and purge their daemons. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/717560/Lucifer_Within_Us/]Watch the trailer and add it to your wishlist now![/url]

[h1]Investigate timelines.[/h1]
Question your suspects. Watch their movements and testimonies closely, as the reconstruction may be based on lies. Use contradictions and clues to form your own hypothesis. Who is lying and why? Who is possessed? You must decide what is the truth for yourself, based on the evidence presented.

[h1]Real mystery-solving.[/h1]
No hidden plot twists, no QTEs, no random puzzles or mini-games, just you and the information. Don’t just act like a detective -- BE a detective. Finding the murderer will require true understanding of the case, not just following the story.

[h1]Banish daemonic A.I.[/h1]
Enter the minds of citizens to gain insight into what they don’t want you to know. Dig through their subconscious and accuse the guilty in order to cast out their daemons, for the good of the Inquisition. Any damage done to a citizen’s psyche as a result of quarantine, exorcism, or rehabilitation is a consequence of their own immorality.

[h1]Expose the False Utopia.[/h1]
Through centuries of indoctrination, humanity is taught to think pure thoughts and speak true words, untainted by falsehoods and delusions. Yet beneath this facade of purity, you find dark desires stir deep within people’s hearts, yearning for release. 

If you want to keep tabs on the game's development, maybe check [url=http://discord.gg/kitfoxgames]out our Discord and the Lucifer Within Us channel[/url], where the devs sometimes hang out with other fans of digital exorcism.

Ain Soph's blessings,
Tanya and the Kitfox team

notes.title: The year in apocalypse
notes.content:
Among Rain World's best tricks is that it doesn't end with you. Fall afoul of the reptiles who coil and flop through its moulting, fungal catacombs and you'll be dragged to a crevice and swiftly guzzled. The restart prompt appears, but you're under no pressure to hit the button, and really, what's your hurry? Death is an opportunity to enjoy Joar Jakobsson's chiselled 16-bit aesthetic and the game's AI ecosystem at leisure, freed from the rat-race of its core mechanics.

Predators come and go from boltholes: depending on where you've copped it, you might even see them fight, tumbling through the muck in a writhing knot, coughing up bright bubbles of neon blood. Light drifts over backdrop layers, burnishing dead machinery and throwing the shadows of unseen structures across the view, an effect that rather uncannily places the environment behind the player, as though you were perched on a rail in the foreground. It's mesmerising and, given Rain World's difficulty, reassuring: where other game worlds turn on the player's motions and decisions, your participation here is never represented as essential. This grotty, inhuman reality was getting on just fine before you arrived, and however hard the rain may fall, it will continue long after you are gone.

Games are fond of ending the world or staging its total corruption, and 2017 has (appropriately enough) delivered a bumper crop of post-apocalyptic and dystopian fantasies - all thrillingly distinct, and each a commentary on or unwitting reflection of historical forces that threaten disaster in reality, from climate change to religious fanaticism. Some of them take a guilty pleasure in the idea. For a role-playing shooter like Destiny 2, the apocalypse continues to be wish-fulfilment for compulsive hoarders and gladiators, a return to a simpler, more permissive "heroic" era, steeped in the pomp and hubris of the Space Race and the work of venerated sci-fi illustrators like Syd Mead and Chesley Bonestell.

Read more…

notes.title: Sunken Sins DLC Now Available... Free!
notes.content:
Your Excellency, misfortune has struck.

[i]The Shrouded Isle: Sunken Sins DLC[/i] has washed up on the shores (for free!) to all current and future owners of [i]The Shrouded Isle.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26483943/ed80f932f1b6f241182f5e71bf954f554dcf3927.jpg[/img] 

A mysterious spiritual contagion has contaminated the village - purify those inflicted before grave consequences fall before us. Lock the infected away in the purification tower and allow the holy salt water to wash away their sins, but know such treatment can have ill effects on the healthy...
 
[i]The Sunken Sins free DLC[/i] features these major improvements:
[list]
[*]An improved inquiry system - discover villager reputations strategically 
[*]New purification tower game mechanic to cure contagions
[*]A lengthened campaign - 5 years until Chernobog's awakening instead of 3
[*]A new cinematic ending to find 
[*]Additional events & personality traits
[*]New art and animations
[*]....Madness...? Or that which this closed society would deem to be so...
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26483943/1ae40a569356362b6ce9c289f11e7e586d7c587d.gif[/img]

Feel free to counsel with your peers in the Steam community or our [url=https://discord.gg/kitfoxgames]Discord server.[/url] Those who wish to keep up with all future Kitfox updates may point their sacrifices towards our [url=https://twitter.com/KitfoxGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/kitfoxgames/]Facebook[/url], or [url=https://www.instagram.com/realkitfoxgames/]Instagram[/url] pages. Let us know how you fare - we await your awakening.
 
May your fervor forever burn,
Priestess Victoria and the Kitfox Cult

notes.title: Beta test the extra-strategic upcoming DLC!
notes.content:
The game's designer, Jongwoo Kim, listened to your feedback and came up with a bunch of new stuff to make The Shrouded Isle better. Not just new events and traits -- whole new mechanics and revising the core inquiry system.

You can beta test the DLC now, if you so desire. Just log into the game's forums and check out the top pinned post to get the details.

It makes the game significantly harder, but more strategic, adding new options and controls. I hope you'll check it out and then fill out the questionnaire (also in that pinned forum post) so we can make it [i]even better[/i] before it goes live in a few weeks.

Thanks in advance for your Discipline and Fervor!
Her Excellency Tanya & House Kitfox

notes.title: Soundtrack Edition now available, 10% off!
notes.content:
Have friends that have been holding off from buying the game? Now is a good time for them to jump in -- [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5360/The_Shrouded_Isle_Soundtrack_Edition/]get 10% off when buying The Shrouded Isle & its OST at the same time.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26483943/3f356db017a410075a24565e7e92220fbfe0280c.png[/img][/url]

Plus, the update last month doubled the soundtrack running time, from 19 to 40 minutes, with 4 new songs from FX Bilodeau, each song corresponding to the fateful final seasons.

Some praise for the Shrouded Isle soundtrack:

" The audio is marvellous, too: each clan has its own introductory orchestral sting, a skitter of pipes and strings that suggests a shaft of sunlight exposing something horrid on a table in a darkened room." - [url=http://www.eurogamer.net/articles/2017-08-03-the-shrouded-isle]Eurogamer[/url]

"If a game’s music is good enough, I’ll sit with it for a while and let it loop, just listening without playing. I found myself doing that in The Shrouded Isle. Each season has a different song, and woven in with the music are visual and aural touches that also coincide with the seasons." - [url=http://www.relyonhorror.com/reviews/review-the-shrouded-isle/]Rely On Horror[/url]

"Accompanied by the music, which is the perfect amount of ominous tones mixed with despair. The rest of the sound design is top quality too " - [url=http://www.hardcoregamer.com/2017/08/04/review-the-shrouded-isle/266928/]Hardcore Gamer[/url]

In Penitence,
Her Excellency Tanya & House Kitfox

notes.title: The Hallowed Spirits Patch
notes.content:
Don your darkest robes, devouts!

All Hallows' Eve (or Hallowe’en, as we hear some call it) has descended upon The Shrouded Isle.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26483943/307ca8f45c52b0eb6e51a2d32badbaa54e60de61.png[/img]
We’ve been sent a dream by Chernobog which says the patch includes:
[list]
 [*]A new spooky color scheme (Jack-O-Lantern)
 [*]A handful of new villager portraits and events
 [*]4 new songs on the soundtrack (all in the final year)
 [*]2 new villager traits (Haunted and Morbid)
 [*]Bug fixes
 [*]21:9 ultrawide screen support
 [*]Text fixes in Korean and Japanese
[/list]
We’re not sure what that means, but we trust as the High Priest you can decipher the unintelligible mutterings of this message.

Additionally, be on the look out for future omens, Your Excellency... we hear there are Things to come.

In fervor and ignorance,
Victoria and the rest of House Kitfox

It's been 1 week since launch and first we must welcome all the new devotees among us. Your mortal coil has pleased Chernobog greatly; He bathes in the blood of the sacrificed and has decided to reward our unworthy souls.

After petitioning to Him for another colour scheme, we now have "Cremation Ashes" - a black and grey skin - available for use.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26483943/aea67c80e099256b323d24eefcb506cd04c22389.png[/img]

Various bugs have been fixed such as the obscured final line of text in the results screen and some broken glyphs in Korean. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/501320/discussions/0/1471967615872295908/]All patch notes can be seen in the forums.[/url]

We thank you for your devotion and look forward to your continued reverence towards Chernobog.

With everlasting piety,
Priestess Victoria and House Kitfox

notes.content:

notes.title: Lead a sacrificial cult in The Shrouded Isle
notes.content: Get away from the hustle and bustle of modern life and seek a simpler life with a lonely island community serving an inscrutable bloodthirsty god in The Shrouded Isle [official site], released today. Yes, our new role in life is high priest of a village where, every season, someone must be sacrificed to our god sleeping beneath the waves. I’ve had worse jobs. But with five local families vying for power (and for not-being-sacrificed), the cult management game might get tricky. (more…)

notes.content:
The Shrouded Isle is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

notes.title: Podcast: The Electronic Wireless Show talks Tacoma, The Shrouded Isle and comfort games
notes.content:
You look tired, traveller. Come in, sit by the fire and listen to the RPS podcast with us, the Electronic Wireless Show. It’s about comfort gaming this week – the things we play when we feel down in the dumps or ill with the flu or just a little cold and tired. Here, drink it all up with your ears, like a nourishing audio broth. Delicious. Adam likes to relax in his cabin in The Long Dark, Pip finds safety in the world of Zelda, while Brendan soothes his sick self with a bit of Final Fantasy IX.

But we’re not done here. Space-walking simulator Tacoma also came out this week and both Pip and Brendan have things to say about it. But so does Karla Zimonja, one of the game’s creators at Fullbright, who takes part in a round of Quickfire Questions. On top of all that, Adam has been putting ignorant cultists in charge of school lessons in The Shrouded Isle, and we also look at what our listeners consider their own go-to comfort games.
(more…)

notes.title: Two Days Remain!
notes.content:
Cry out, penitents, that in two days our prayers are answered.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26483943/23a41aa98d41f8bc89e657f4be35afb4ecaffc69.png[/img]

notes.title: Dark Offerings Fan Art Contest
notes.content:
We couldn’t sleep last night. Bleary eyed, drenched in sweat and hearts pounding, we are writing this to you now as a plea. It is time. It is [i]time.[/i]

An omen has come to us, dear players. We must appease the premonitions and announce that our Dark Lord has demanded offerings. Submit your visual art as proof of your worthiness and piety. So long as it is set within the Shrouded Isle universe, it may be in whatever medium you please — art, photos, costume, etc. Prove your reverence before it’s too late.

[b]Two devotees who have pleased Our Dark Lord will receive secret access to the Shrouded Isle beta on June 29th + their portrait in game + an exclusive art print! (Pictured below).

To enter: Submit your links or photos to info@kitfoxgames.com OR tweet your art and tag us @KitfoxGames by 11:59 PM EST on June 29th, 2017.[/b]

Art print you could win:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26483943/f04dd77f560db8fbedc51f11e43dc018b7a6c9ff.png[/img]

You can check the [url=http://www.kitfoxgames.com/press/sheet.php?p=shrouded_isle]Presskit page[/url] or our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Jsim52UC74&feature=youtu.be]YouTube playtest video[/url] for references and inspiration.

Abide by the rules:
- The work must be your own.
- It must involve The Shrouded Isle characters or settings.
- You can submit multiple pieces, but sending more doesn’t increase your odds of winning.
- No offensive language or inappropriate images (other than what is relevant to The Shrouded Isle theme) in your submissions, please.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26483943/0b59160709f65e70d04750abb68251affabfac41.jpg[/img]

The Kitfox cult (of 6 unworthy members) will be casting our votes for our top two picks, which we’ll tally up and announce after the end of the sacrifice. The winners will be contacted by the e-mail or account they used to submit their work, and all of the submissions will be collected on a post here on our blog.

We pray for your survival,
Kitfox Cult
----

notes.title: The Shrouded Isle Beta Sign Up
notes.content:
Do you like being part of a horrific cult with an affinity for human sacrifice? Yes? Then you should [url=http://eepurl.com/cQTbEn]sign up for The Shrouded Isle beta test![/url]

We're opening up spots for a closed beta and would love to have you join us for the Lovecraftian ride. Candidates for the beta will be chosen randomly on June 15th! (We promise you won't receive any newsletters if you sign up, by the way -- the list is purely for contact info.)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26483943/41a4c110e330f0460c06caae7b1c2b1e6755b937.gif[/img]

Beta testers will receive exclusive, secret access to the Shrouded Isle and a feedback forum, in order to give us your honest feedback on gameplay, interface, help us track down bugs, etc.

Serious thanks to all of you who sign up! Our games wouldn't be the same without you.

Praise Chernobog,

Victoria & the Kitfox Cult

notes.title: Twitch Canvas launches with a Shrouded Isle palette!
notes.content:
Starting right now (plus or minus 5 minutes), you can go 
play with [url=https://www.twitch.tv/kitfoxgames]"Twitch Canvas" on the Kitfox Games Twitch channel[/url]. Twitch Canvas is a new little painting toy that allows the id of Twitch to make whatever pixel art it desires.

We'll be patching in some improvements and experimental functionality next week probably, but for this weekend, the only colors available are taken straight from The Shrouded Isle. SpooOoOooky.

If you have suggestions for Twitch Canvas, you can comment here, or tweet at us... and of course, feel free to send a little high-five to its [url=https://twitter.com/ScientistSloth]genius programmer, Marcelo, better known online as @scientistsloth[/url]!

Cheers,
Tanya

notes.title: Conduct Mayoral Sacrificial Duties In The Shrouded Isle
notes.content: I’m not sure what’s going on in The Shrouded Isle [official site] but that’s why I’m so intrigued. Just look at it. What’s that all about? According to Steam, you take up the role of mayor of a seaside village. Sounds friendly enough. I wonder what kind of duties I’ll have there — oh, wait. It looks like I’ll need to “sate the blood-hunger of gods sleeping beneath the waves.” Well, consider my interest piqued. … [visit site to read more]
